title: Prefix
statement: The task is to process an array of n (n up to 50, |a_i| up to 50) left to right, replacing each a_i with a_i - s, a_i, or a_i + s where s is the current prefix sum, and maximize the largest final element (answers exceed 32 bits). Element i reaches a_i + |s|, so a dp keeps only the maximum and minimum reachable prefix sum.
